description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling AttributesCreated events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy and applies the event data to a ThingBuilder to update attributes.

classes.name: AttributesCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a strategy to handle AttributesCreated events, updating thing attributes accordingly.

methods.name: AttributesCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Constructor, protected, calls the superclass constructor.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides a method to apply an AttributesCreated event to a ThingBuilder by setting the created attributes.
